title: Deceptive Employment Scheme: IT worker activity
summary: OpenAI banned accounts associated with suspected deceptive employment campaigns that used AI to develop materials for potentially fraudulent remote-job applications.
body: OpenAI banned accounts associated with suspected deceptive employment campaigns that used AI to develop materials for potentially fraudulent remote-job applications.
summaryZh: OpenAI采取行动封禁了与欺诈性远程职位申请活动相关的账号，这些账号利用AI技术自动生成虚假求职材料和简历，体现了AI安全治理在招聘欺诈领域的应对。

aiReview.reasonZh: 揭示了利用生成式AI进行远程工作欺诈申请的滥用行为及相关封禁措施。
